title: 开始阅读最后更新：2026-07-26 05:29:04 最新章节：第156章 恐惧孕育信仰
content_zh:
李青山的压力有点大。
前世开百吨王的时候，压力都没这么大过。
是的，李青山穿越了。
穿越古代农户家庭马上十六载，还是家里长子。
今日他见同村泼皮张三伙同侄子，一起调戏自己妹妹，边上还倒着自己鼻青脸肿的弟弟。
李青山来不及想这两人今天为何敢招惹自己家，便冲上去干架，打的张三那侄子毫无还手之力，却被张三出手偷袭，一石头拍晕。
这一石头，也帮李青山觉醒了胎中之谜。
...
“早知道上辈子就不那么用力的活着了！
玛德，用力过猛，跟着车头一起变成了夹心饼干，也不知辛苦攒下的房车媳妇存款，最后便宜了哪个王八蛋...”
李青山感受着额头的刺痛，又扫了眼黄土垒造的小房间，叹了口气。
这一世，他重生在了一个古代环境的村落。
村子周围石头多，就叫石头村。
石头村一共有一百多户，十几个姓氏，都是最早一批来这里的流民后代。
根据之前的记忆，这一片区域的统治者，不是所谓的官府，也没听过这一片土地有皇帝。
石头村，包括周围几十个村乡镇县，都由一个名为铁腿门的武道门派统治。
偶有商队来村里借宿，透露过一些外界的信息。
只知晓铁腿门很强，外面很乱。
更多的东西，就不是李青山这个农户之子能够知晓。
他现在也没空理会这些。

翻阅之前记忆后，李青山立刻意识到一个非常严重的问题。
他家危险了。
问题就出在张三这里。
...
李青山之前对张三的印象，就是个窝里横的懒汉。
这家伙今年二十多岁，是家里老小，头上有两个大哥，都是老实的农村汉子，已经娶妻生子，有几个姐姐，也都嫁到了外村。
张三从小被惯着，懒惯了，长大后也没变勤奋起来，每天游手好闲，趴在全家身上吸血。
张三倒是想过在外面也欺男霸女。
但他家成年男丁不过四人，在村里狗屁不是，被人打了一顿后就老实了，转而只敢欺压家里。
这种玩意，说他是泼皮都是抬举。
相比之下，李青山家里完全是另一个极端。
单单是他家里，就有他这个十六岁的成丁，下面还有三个弟弟，两个妹妹。
父亲那一辈，他爸排老六，有哥哥五人，弟弟两人。
这七个叔伯下面又都不止一个儿子。
可以说。
李姓在石头村，就是最大的姓氏。
因为这个缘故。
石头村的村正，也是由李青山的爷爷担任。
平日里，张三和他那个从小就胆小的侄子，躲着李家人都来不及，哪敢惹他们李家人。
content_en:
Li Qingshan was under a bit of pressure.
When I was driving the 100-ton King in my previous life, the pressure was never this great.
Yes, Li Qingshan traveled through time.
Traveling through an ancient farming family for almost sixteen years, he is still the eldest son in the family.
Today he saw Zhang San, a gangster from the same village, teasing his younger sister with his nephew, and his younger brother with a bruised nose and face was beside him.
Li Qingshan didn't have time to think about why these two people dared to provoke his family today, so he rushed to fight and beat Zhang San's nephew, who was unable to fight back. However, Zhang San made a sneak attack and knocked him unconscious with a stone.
This stone also helped Li Qingshan awaken to the mystery of the womb.
...
“If I had known, I wouldn’t have lived so hard in my previous life!
Mu De, you used too much force and turned into a sandwich biscuit along with the front of the car. I don’t know which bastard got a better deal in the end with my hard-earned savings for the RV..."
Li Qingshan felt the stinging pain on his forehead, glanced at the small room made of loess, and sighed.
In this life, he was reborn in a village in an ancient environment.
There are many stones around the village, so it is called Stone Village.
There are more than a hundred households in Stone Village with more than a dozen surnames, all descendants of the first batch of refugees who came here.
According to previous memories, the ruler of this area is not a so-called official government, and I have never heard of an emperor in this land.
Stone Village, including dozens of surrounding villages, towns and counties, is ruled by a martial arts sect called Iron Leg Sect.
Occasionally, caravans come to stay in the village and reveal some information about the outside world.
All I know is that the iron leg gate is very strong and it’s very messy outside.
There are more things that Li Qingshan, the son of a farmer, cannot know.
He has no time to pay attention to this now.
After reviewing his previous memories, Li Qingshan immediately realized a very serious problem.
His home is in danger.
The problem lies with Zhang San.
...
Li Qingshan's previous impression of Zhang San was that he was a lazy guy who was always in trouble.
This guy is in his twenties and is the youngest of the family. He has two eldest brothers, both honest rural men. They are already married and have children. Several of his sisters have also been married to other villages.
Zhang San has been spoiled and lazy since he was a child, and he has not become more diligent when he grows up. He idles around every day and sucks blood from the whole family.
Zhang San has thought about bullying men and women outside.
But there were only four adult males in his family, and they were no good in the village. After being beaten, they became obedient and only dared to bully the family.
This kind of thing, saying he is a rogue is an exaggeration.
In contrast, Li Qingshan's family is completely on the other extreme.
In his family alone, he is a sixteen-year-old adult, with three younger brothers and two younger sisters.
In his father's generation, his father was the sixth child, with five older brothers and two younger brothers.
These seven uncles all have more than one son.
It can be said.
The surname Li is the most common surname in Stone Village.
Because of this.
The village leader of Stone Village is also held by Li Qingshan's grandfather.
On weekdays, Zhang San and his nephew, who had been timid since childhood, had no time to hide from the Li family, so how could they dare to offend them.
